detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning
detail.summary: This revision integrates the GOAL-Robots project paradigm into the taxonomy of curiosity-driven learning (CDL), illustrating that autonomous research capabilities emerge from the synergy between arousal-based intrinsic motivation and self-generated task objectives.
detail.reason: Incorporating GOAL-Robots source as a practical implementation of the goal-generation theoretical framework discussed in CDL literature.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Continuing inquiry into autonomous gap identification frameworks.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: How does accumulated path-dependent experience shape emergent preferences in adaptive agents?
detail.reason: Maintaining active inquiry into preference formation mechanisms.
